global_caption: The video contains two shots. The Emotional tone remains consistently fiery and uplifting, with lighting dominated by high-contrast side lighting and neon reflections.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in from black, using a wide-angle low-angle composition. In the foreground, the edge of a massive slowly rotating gear partially obscures the view. In the midground, a lion with metallic mane stands at the center of an elevated gear bridge. The background features layered steam-powered buildings, neon pipes, and steel skybridges extending into the distance. Leading lines formed by rivets and light strips on the bridge converge toward the subject. The depth of field is moderately deep to ensure clarity of the mechanical city environment. Warm orange-red neon reflections cast from the side of the buildings illuminate the scene, while high-contrast side lighting defines the metallic edges of the lion's mane. Occasional bursts of steam erupt from beneath the bridge, momentarily enveloping the lion in mist. The lion initially lowers its head, gathering momentum, then steps forward across the bridge. Its paws cause slight vibrations in the bridge surface, and the metallic plates of its mane and chain ornament at the tail sway rhythmically with each step. The gears beneath the bridge rotate in sync, demonstrating physical follow-through. Initially, the text extends along the bridge surface, then ascends staggered onto the facades of the surrounding buildings. The edges of the letters glow with orange electrical arcs and faint steam refractions, arranged in varying heights to create a sense of urban billboard pressure. When 'rust' is sung, a burst of steam shoots from a crack in the bridge.
shot2: The second shot cuts abruptly from the previous one and quickly pushes into a close-up, moving inside the Mechanical Core Plaza. The composition is a close-up at eye level with a slight upward angle: in the foreground, translucent steam drifts across the frame along with rotating copper pipes brushing the edges; the midground focuses on the lion's head, shoulders, neck, and front paws; the background reveals a radial mechanical space composed of multi-layered circular fans, pressure gauges, piston rods, and steam valves. Lighting continues the warm cyberpunk aesthetic from the prior shot, but high-contrast side lighting is more intensely focused on the lion's face and metallic mane. Copper reflections and backlighting along the steam edges amplify the explosive power of the roar. As the camera advances, the lion suddenly roars and turns, its shoulder mechanical plates unfolding while high-pressure white mist erupts from the copper pipes. The ground vibrates, causing small bolts nearby to jump slightly. Fans behind it accelerate, lifting steam and fabric banners with the airflow. The motion completes a full arc—from tension buildup to explosive release, culminating in a sharp turn and freeze-frame. The text features brushed metal texture and glowing orange edges, fading out gradually at the end of the sentence.
